title: (Hom-surj) for the constructible cocone
statement:
Let $\ell$ be a prime and $X$ a scheme whose underlying topological space is Noetherian. The
constructible cocone ([def-sfb-constructible-cocone]) satisfies (Hom-surj) of
[sk-def-sfb-filtered-two-colimit]: for finite extensions $E,F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in $\Qlb$,
$K_E\in D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,E)$, $L_F\in D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,F)$ and every morphism
$\varphi\colon T_{E,\Qlb}K_E\to T_{F,\Qlb}L_F$, there are a finite extension $H\supseteq E,F$ and
a morphism $g\colon T_{E,H}K_E\to T_{F,H}L_F$ in $D_{\mathrm{cons}}(X,H)$ with
$\varphi=T_{H,\Qlb}(g)$ up to the transitivity isomorphisms.

proof.text: Put $\Omega=\Qlb$ and let $I$ be the poset of finite subfields containing $E,F$. It is small, nonempty and directed by [det-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed-subextensions]. Its inclusion in all finite subfields is final: for any $G$, the fields containing $E,F,G$ form a nonempty directed upper poset. Since $L_F$ is bounded [def-sfb-dcons-subfield], apply [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-presentation]. Obtain $N,c$ with a common termwise lower bound and isomorphisms $e_H:QN_H\cong U_{H,E}T_{F,H}L_F$ and $e_\Omega:Q(c.\mathrm{pt})\cong U_{\Omega,E}T_{F,\Omega}L_F$, satisfying its compatibility equation.

source.place: Paragraph 2: uniformly bounded-below Hom continuity and finite cone devissage

proof.text: By [lem-sfb-condensed-bounded-hom-continuity], applied to $K_E,N,c$, the canonical map $\varinjlim_H\operatorname{Hom}(K_E,QN_H)\to\operatorname{Hom}(K_E,Q(c.\mathrm{pt}))$ is bijective. All hypotheses hold by step 1 and the given bounded constructibility of $K_E$.

source.place: Paragraph 2: uniformly bounded-below Hom continuity and finite cone devissage

proof.text: Use the adjunction bijections $a_H,a_\Omega$ of [def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison]. Let $v=e_\Omega^{-1}\circ a_\Omega(\varphi)$. Step 2 and [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise](1), for $\mathbf Z$-modules, give $H\in I$ and $u:K_E\to QN_H$ with $v=Q(c.\iota_H)\circ u$. Set $g=a_H^{-1}(e_H\circ u):T_{E,H}K_E\to T_{F,H}L_F$.

source.place: Paragraph 2: uniformly bounded-below Hom continuity and finite cone devissage

proof.text: The compatibility equation of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-presentation] gives $a_\Omega(\theta_{F,H}\circ T_{H,\Omega}(g)\circ\theta_{E,H}^{-1})=e_\Omega\circ Q(c.\iota_H)\circ u=a_\Omega(\varphi)$. Cancel the bijection $a_\Omega$. By [lem-sfb-coefficient-cocone-comparison-agreement], these are exactly the cocone comparisons. By [lem-sfb-extend-subfield-constructible] both endpoints of $g$ are bounded constructible; fullness [def-sfb-dcons-subfield] makes $g$ an arrow there. Since $H\supseteq E,F$, this proves (Hom-surj) for [def-sfb-constructible-cocone].

Item: statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical to live and to blueprint main-20261015. The proof is now a 4-step assembly of 1806 characters. proof_deps equals the union of uses. The closure has 3173 nodes, contains no cycle and does not reach prop-weil-pbc-qbar-condensed-two-colimit. No SGA is cited.
- Step 1: the presentation lemma's hypotheses hold. I is the poset of finite fields containing E and F; it is nonempty and directed by composita and its inclusion is final. L_F is bounded. Coefficients match: Ω_X is finite-subfield-valued and C(-,E) is the restricted ring.
- Step 2: applies the new continuity node at n=0 with all hypotheses met. Advisory: the step does not say that a colimit cocone of complexes is computed degreewise. That is one standard line, not a fault.
- Step 3: the elementwise leaf (1) at R=ℤ gives H and u. g=a_H^{-1}(e_H∘u) has the claimed source and target.
- Step 4: the compatibility clause, after cancelling a_Ω, gives φ=θ_F∘T(g)∘θ_E^{-1}, exactly the (Hom-surj) shape. The agreement node identifies θ with the cocone comparisons. Fullness and lem-sfb-extend-subfield-constructible put g in D_cons(X,H).

New lem-sfb-condensed-bounded-hom-continuity: statement-only and self-contained.
- True: it is the sheaf Ext-continuity lemma (same topologically Noetherian hypothesis, same lfp constructibility, same lower bound), extended by the cone witness, the shift closure and the extension lemma (the old steps 2–3).
- Not a duplicate: sk-lem-constructible-ext-continuity and det-lem-…-devissage need locally Noetherian and quasi-compact X plus constant-model constructibility. lem-sfb-constructible-internal-hom-continuity concerns internal RHom, under the constant-model notion.
- Small cases checked: empty X, K=0, and K=M[0].

New lem-sfb-coefficient-cocone-comparison-agreement:
- True: the def-weil-pbc θ and the def-sfb-derived-extend-comp-iso proof are the same construction, along the same ring maps. The constructible version is the unique full-subcategory lift, inverse components included.
- Not a duplicate: the two comp-iso defs give only the isomorphism, not its equality with the presentation's θ.

Neither new node restates the item. Accepted tool_uses: det-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed-subextensions, lem-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-presentation, def-weil-pbc-finite-derived-tensor-comparison. No fixes. Details in review.md.
